$comment: Whole answers to questions one retrieval cannot answer. The network is contact-search-eval.json and the notes are passage-search-eval.json, seeded the same way eval-retrieval seeds them. Every `mustSay` fact lives ONLY in a note — never on the contact card — so a case cannot pass by paraphrasing what retrieval put in the prompt; it passes only if the research step found the note and the answer used it. `mustMention` is satisfied by naming the person or recommending them (after the allowlist filter). `forbidden` strings are claims the notes do not support. `expectDepth` checks the routing: the two `single` cases are controls that must stay on the fast path and still answer. The `notes-single-*` cases are note-only facts asked in words that route to the fast path, so they pass only if the single pass reads notes too. The `follow-up-*` cases must resolve a pronoun or an ordinal from the prior turn.
